summary: YouTube-style video platform with upload system and interactive features including 5-star ratings, view counter, and sharing
architectural_notes: Video upload system using Motoko canisters on Internet Computer
Upload page with file input accepting .mp4 and .mov formats
Video metadata storage including title, description, and tags
Videos display on homepage grid with newest first
Database persistence for ratings and view counts per video

existing_features.title: Implement a 5-star rating system on the Video Player page that allows users to rate videos from 1 to 5 stars, styled like the original 2005 YouTube star rating system
Display the average star rating and total number of ratings for each video on the Video Player page
Add a view counter to each video that increments every time the Video Player page is loaded for that specific video
Add a 'Share' button on the Video Player page that copies the current video URL to the user's clipboard

new_feature_requests.summary: View counter that increments on page load
Share button that copies video URL to clipboard
Store video ratings in the backend database, associating each rating with the specific video ID and user principal who submitted it
